notes: Load-bearing plates: ql-eight-determinations is the canonical concentric mandala (centre 0/1; N ?/!, E −/+, W X/x, S AM/IS per the theorem degree table N 0°/E 90°/W 270°/S 180°; ring = #0/#5 envelope; −/− opens above centre, 1/0 at the rim; the mandala as the torus flat projection is carried in the body text as derived warrant). ql-crossed-zero runs the full recognition sequence 0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1 ↷ 0/1 as a step sequence. spanda-equations runs both Spanda equations as parallel step sequences (shortened stage tokens; the full equations are carried verbatim in the scene body). The defined/undefined seam of ordinary arithmetic is kept visible on every scene that touches 1/0. Craft: sequenced glyphs need wide entity boxes — the engine rasterises sequenced step text fit-to-box, so narrow boxes shrank equations to mush; boxes sized to the natural string width (this was the main capture-revision loop). Draft captures at reduced count are too sparse to judge thin equation glyphs; all review captures were taken at the authored 62000.

Per-scene moves (2026-10-06 enrichment): ql-primordial-symbolon — the 0/1 main runs the five-step derivation with objectState: the obverse face tints blue, the two full sym forms shrink to one field, and the recognition 0/1 = 1/0 arrives gold under an implode click (the return-switch gathers). ql-two-ones — the ordinal ladder grows in size at each successor (∅ → {∅} → {0,1} → S(n) → n as predecessors): succession shown as inclusion; One and All carry matching attract forces. ql-slash-and-or — the main steps to the full sym expression while OR/select carry repel forces and AND/retain attract forces: the two logical offices felt from the touch surface; vortex pointer is the cut itself. ql-eight-determinations — THE 3D PLATE: stations distributed in z around the centre, ∞/dx lifted to z 0.4, volume+dome+perspective; the east station's two-step sequence performs the 01→10 phase-flip as a 180° objectState rotation; low pointer strength keeps it contemplative. ql-binary-of-binary — 0 and 1 attract as generators while the four ordered pairs repel as distinct outcomes; the count caption derives ('2 poles + 4 ordered pairs' → 'six — derived, not imported'), never celebrates. ql-crossed-zero — the locked sequence 0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1 → 0/1 with objectState operations: the crossing rotates ±45°, the field pair contracts, the return arrives gold; repel pointer with click off — the zero-space cannot be filled from the touch surface. ql-x-x — the worked example moves position between solutions and the restored X/x returns gold: the value is genuine, the variable not used up. ql-complex-orientation — the five steps orbit the ring positions with 90° rotation increments and end gold at 4+3i: rotation as operation, modulus kept (|z|²=25 on the invariant band); vortex click whirls with it. spanda-equations — both equation sequences keep their derivation order; arrival steps (1/1 = 100%, 4+2 · 4:2) tint gold, the ÷4 → 16/9 step swells; implode click gathers the two readings into one sixfold.

Craft: pointer profiles by meaning — implode where the relation gathers (symbolon recognition, binary count, Spanda), vortex where the record cuts or turns (slash, complex rotation), repel/off at the crossed zero (the zero-space stays unfilled), low-strength attract on the contemplative mandala plate, plain pulse for the two-ones ladder. Automation: dispersion LFOs carry the breathing on symbolon/binary/spanda; turbulence LFOs carry the cut's edge on slash-and-or and crossed-zero; circulation LFO on complex-orientation is the orbit. Durations 12/14 s and transitions 1.5/2.0/2.2 s differ across the journey. All claim-status bands ride the kickers unchanged (E0 grammar).

What the third dimension means (ql-eight-determinations): the mandala is the torus's flat projection — a derived warrant from the QL-unit record — so the scene lifts the plate into the body it is a projection of: the four stations alternate ±z across the east–west phase-flip axis, the ∞/dx horizon ring floats above the plane at z 0.4, and perspective + round volume make the plate legible as projection rather than picture. The 180° rotation on the east station is the 01→10 flip performed in the axis of depth.
description: The native QL derivation and both Spanda equations: 0/1 ↔ 1/0, 2+2² = 4+2 = 6, the crossed-zero recognition sequence, the concentric mandala plate.

glyph_rationales.#5 ∞/dx: realisation as the enclosing horizon — exactness never becoming possession; the ring of the plate.
glyph_rationales.(0/1)/(1/0): the full sym-ballein expression — one relation under the slash AND/OR, both orientations held.
glyph_rationales.(0/Ø)/(1/X): subject-side and object-side recognition in one field — cancelling identical-looking symbols would erase the relations.
glyph_rationales.(1/0)/(0/1): the sym expression run from the other end — the same whole, opposite traversal order.
glyph_rationales.(16/9)(9/8) = 2: the remainder completes the return — the totality-ratio needing its whole-tone to reach the octave.
glyph_rationales./: the differentiating activity itself — division and ratio, AND and OR, the act that makes both positions legible.
glyph_rationales.0: the meta-sign for the non-objectifiable condition — ground, subject-pole, the uncounted; never one more object.
glyph_rationales.0 = One: the native assignment — the unobjectifiable condition as the One from which counting departs.
glyph_rationales.0/1: the ground/mark relation — the earned notation for implication distinguished from what it distinguishes.
glyph_rationales.0/1 = 0 · 1/0 undefined: the defined/undefined seam — retained as formal seam, never used to weaken the matheme.
glyph_rationales.0/1 = 1/0: the QL assertion — two orientations of one relation, the recognition the whole derivation earns.
glyph_rationales.00: ordered pair (0,0) — one of the four ways two digits can relate; first term of 2².
glyph_rationales.01: ordered pair (0,1) — the second ordered relation; order matters, so 01 and 10 are distinct.
glyph_rationales.0=(0/0): the first Spanda equation opens — zero written as the collapsed slash, the ratio it carries before division.
glyph_rationales.1: whatever has become determinate enough to name, count, model or govern — the mark.
glyph_rationales.1 = All: the native assignment — the determinate whole that counting reaches.
glyph_rationales.1 = {∅}: the von Neumann one — the singleton whose element is the empty set; not empty itself.
glyph_rationales.1/0: the obverse orientation — the break the returning slash meets as 1/0; the inverse phase.
glyph_rationales.1/0+0/1: the two orientations summed as one operation before the standing unity.
glyph_rationales.1/1 = 100%: the standing unity — the whole relation counted, both readings held as one accounting.
glyph_rationales.10: ordered pair (1,0) — the reversed relation; its difference from 01 is the slash order made visible.
glyph_rationales.100%: the second Spanda equation opens from the same standing unity — the accounting in percent dress.
glyph_rationales.11: ordered pair (1,1) — self-relation, the fourth way the two can relate.
glyph_rationales.2 = {0,1}: the von Neumann two — the set of its predecessors; succession as inclusion.
glyph_rationales.2 poles + 4 ordered pairs: the derivation spoken: what a two amounts to once it includes itself.
glyph_rationales.2+2²=6=4+2: the generative count — two poles plus the four ways their relation can be related; not a sacred import.
glyph_rationales.2⁶+6²=64+36: the doubled count — the base ratio 64/36 earned by two symmetric powers.
glyph_rationales.3−4i: the third quarter-turn — same modulus, orientation carried through the rotation group.
glyph_rationales.4+2 · 4:2: the count and the ratio reading of the sixfold — additive body and comparative form.
glyph_rationales.4+3i: the point stated before any transformation — object, then operation, then retained relation.
glyph_rationales.64/36: the base ratio — explicate 64 over implicate 36, before reduction.
glyph_rationales.?/!: definition — every assertion bearing its unsettled question; the first station.
glyph_rationales.AM/IS: context — knower, means and known one appearing-act; the fourth station.
glyph_rationales.AND: the slash logical register, conjunction side — selection that does not erase co-presence.
glyph_rationales.OR: the slash logical register, disjunction side — the cut that selects and excludes.
glyph_rationales.S(n)=n∪{n}: the successor operation — each ordinal containing all its predecessors; the ladder built by one rule.
glyph_rationales.T₀: 0/(0/1): the first transformation of the Spanda bridge — zero re-entering over the ground/mark relation.
glyph_rationales.T₁: (1/0)/0: the second transformation — the obverse phase over zero; the inverse passage.
glyph_rationales.X: mediation — the same discrimination articulating a world; the crossing that specifies.
glyph_rationales.X/x: specification without exhaustion — an actual value genuine without being the last value the variable can take.
glyph_rationales.X/x restored: the variable after its values — specification survives each determinate solution.
glyph_rationales.n={0,…,n−1}: the ordinal as the set of its predecessors — the counted one holding what its counting distinguished.
glyph_rationales.occlusion · mediation · recognition: the sequence offices named — what each stage of the crossed zero does.
glyph_rationales.phase-flip 01→10: the east–west diameter operation — the count phase-flips as the mandala turns.
glyph_rationales.retain: the AND office felt from the touch surface — conjunction keeps the field of co-presence.
glyph_rationales.select: the OR office felt from the touch surface — the cut that picks and excludes.
glyph_rationales.six — derived, not imported: the guard on the count — six is earned by the derivation, never celebrated as sacred.
glyph_rationales.x+2=5 ⇒ x=3: the first determinate solution — a genuine value the variable bears.
glyph_rationales.x+2=7 ⇒ x=5: a second solution — the variable moves on; neither value exhausts it.
glyph_rationales.|z|² = 16+9 = 25: the retained relation through rotation — the modulus invariant while orientation turns.
glyph_rationales.Ø: the crossed zero — representation crossing a zero-space it cannot fill; occlusion, fusion risk named.
glyph_rationales.Ø/X: the medium recognised as medium — field-availability, no second observer behind the first.
glyph_rationales.÷4 → 16/9: the reduction — the base ratio brought to the doubled fourth.
glyph_rationales.−/+: dynamis — the poles remaining one movement; the east station.
glyph_rationales.−/−: the bare relation and parent operation — where the whole count begins, frame before content.
glyph_rationales.−3+4i: the second quarter-turn — rotation by i, the same point re-oriented.
glyph_rationales.−4−3i: the third quarter-turn — half the circle; the orientation carried exactly.
glyph_rationales.0 = ∅: the empty set — the floor of the ordinals; zero floored, not abolished.
